The issue involved in the present petition is whether on the date of the commission of the alleged offence punishable under Section 376 of the 13:58:42 IST Reason:
Indian Penal Code, the petitioner (accused) was a juvenile or not.
The trial has proceeded on the basis that the petitioner herein was not a juvenile and is to be tried like any other accused.

The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner invited our attention to the deposition of the prosecutrix (PW-1) recorded by the trial court.
We only need to look into the examination-in-chief.

The same reads thus:
In the year 2012, I was studying in Govt. High School, village Kakran in 10th class.
Accused was my classmate and he was intended to get marry with me and we were having affair.

In 2012 accused told me that his mother wanted to meet me so he told me to get the key of my Bhuas house from my mother as my bhua was residing in Gurudawara sahib and that house was empty and I used to go there for cleaning that house and on that day on the pretext of cleaning that house I took the key from my mother and I went to my bhuas hous where accused came alone.
I asked him about his mother, he told me that she was coming behind him.
After some he told me that he had hard some noise from outside and I went outside.
Then I came inside the house and at that very moment accused started beating me and he pulled my hairs and slabbed me and committed rape with me forcibly.
After combing my hair and myself stable I came back my home.

After 2-3 days accused made call to me and told me that he had made the video of the occurrence of rape and I made request to him not to show that video to any one as my father was having good reputation and it would spoil his reputation.
Accused told me that he will not show the video to any one but I will have to obey his order and will have to give him money and to develop physical relations with him.
After this whenever accused called me I went to him to meet him in my bhuas house and many times I paid him money also and the accused every time committed rape with me.
Then my parents fixed my marriage and I was got married on 21.1.2013.
I thought that now accused will not threatened me but after my marriage accused arranged the number of my husband and send SMS on the 3 rd day after my marriage.
I was shocked, then accused started sending messages regularly.
I also made message of request to him that he should not send massages to me as I had got married and it will spoil my married life.
Accused again raised the demand of money and pressurized to meet me.
Then he started me sending obscene as well as threatening messages.
Then I switched off my mobile after 6.3.2013.

On 30.3.2013 my husband went in a kirtan darbar and I was alone at home which is in gurudawara sahib where the accused came to my house and threatened me to put my video on net and committed rape with me, when I was pregnant.
I did not disclose this fact to my husband.
On 30.1.2013, my husband was not at home, accused came to my house, he asked for money and beaten me.
He scattered the things in search of money and went away.
Then I told my husband the whole occurrence.
Then we discussed the matter in family and ultimately we decided to register an FIR against the accused, so that he could not spoil the life of any other girl.
I was going to inform the police with my husband.
The police met me at chowk, Laddowal and got recorded my statement Ex.PA and it bears my signatures as Ex.PA/1 and my husband also signed the said statement.
We also gave the photocopy of SMS of my mobile to the police.
On next day I was got medically examined.
3 Prima facie, it appears that the alleged act of rape was committed on 30 March 2013.

On that day, the petitioner was indisputably a juvenile keeping in mind his date of birth Bittu Singh vs The State Of Punjab on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155093893/
2 being 8 April 1995.

sentences.text: He attained majority on 8 April 2013.
In between, the prosecutrix had already got married to some other person.
The allegations of administration of threats and extortion are later in point of time i.e. 30 November 2013.
By that time, the petitioner had attained majority.
4 The short point that falls for our consideration is whether for the alleged offence of rape, the petitioner should be tried as a juvenile under the provisions of the Juvenile Justice Act?
5 At this stage, the learned counsel appearing for the State prayed for some time to file appropriate counter and take further instructions in the matter.
6 We are informed that the trial is now at the stage of the recording of the defense evidence.
7 In such circumstances, referred to above, the further proceedings of Sessions Case No 62 of 2015 pending in the court of Additional Sessions Judge, Ludhiana, shall remain stayed.
8 List the Special Leave Petition after six weeks.

(CHETAN KUMAR) (SAROJ KUMARI GAUR)
